work.originalTitle: ピョ・ウンジ1st写真集 輪舞曲
work.summary: Rondo, the Japanese KADOKAWA photobook of Korean model/YouTuber 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), has separate print and electronic editions released 2023-08-10. The distinct all-other-photo companion 円舞曲 is catalogued as its own title.

editions.contentSummary: Official KADOKAWA electronic Rondo edition, publisher release 2023-08-10. Apple Books Japan publicly reports 136 digital pages, file size 74.7 MB, publisher KADOKAWA, seller DWANGO Co., Ltd., and displayed JPY 3,400 on 2026-10-23. Page/file figures are Apple-specific; ebook file format is unverified. Print A4/128-page specifications, ISBN 9784048976268 and JPY 3,300 paper price are not copied into the ebook. Public preview pricing does not establish account/storefront purchase eligibility. Publisher cover remains the source-attributed remote cover; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.

Japanese print photobook Rondo featuring 표은지 / ピョ・ウンジ / Pyo Eunji. Official publisher lists 128 pages, A4, publication 2023-08-10 and reference list price JPY 3,300 including tax. The artist store gives dimensions 29.7×21×1cm and currently displays MYR 97.00, with disabled cart and a members-only notice. Ordinary book is not an autograph-event ticket; current preorder-photo eligibility is unverified. Separate digital/alternate-photo editions are not represented. Public artist-store cover and three additional product-image URLs are linked with source attribution; pixels are not mirrored and no reuse license is asserted. Additional images are product-page references, not verified interior-page samples.
